How I work

The dashboard is the feedback loop.

I connect the campaign, landing experience and storefront, then use the resulting behavior to decide what changes next.

  1. 01
    Measure the commercial goal

    Revenue, orders, conversion, search attribution or campaign action—depending on the job.

  2. 02
    Find the friction or opportunity

    Read the signal across acquisition, offer, page experience and buying flow.

  3. 03
    Change the system

    Optimize the creative, message, UX, merchandising, SEO or implementation.

  4. 04
    Verify the effect

    Return to the source dashboard and keep only what the evidence supports.
